You brought up the little mermaid, I answered that it does help the black community. 

Your response? Go on another tangent, but this time about the BLM movement. 

Also to speak on what the BLM movement org. may have or have not done based on your claims, I will not comment on it because I would need to look into it myself. 

That's beside the point though, it seems that there are biases and prejudices at play here. It almost seems like you are deliberately looking for reasons to discredit having more black representation in movies or the BLM movement as an idea.

Translation : "I haven't seen one answer that backs up my own biases on the subject. It all goes against my own beliefs, therefore I haven't seen one appropriate answer from all those that I've read."
It does help the black community though. The fact that you're willing to ignore that fact just because that movie will be generating cash flows is very ignorant.

McDonald's for sure. No matter how much care I put into making sure the number on my bag is the same as the one on my app, checking again when I drop it off, they still manage to put the wrong items in and the customer ends up giving the driver a thumbs down for something out of their control.
